## Overview

Resolves the children of `node`. Called at most once per node for a successful load.
A rejection puts the node in the `error` state (see `TreeService.retry`).

- **Kind:** Type alias
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/tree/tree.types.ts:22](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/tree/tree.types.ts#L22)
